name: Text to speech
description: Turn any text into a spoken WAV in the browser with a BYOK OpenRouter key. Six voices, streamed pcm16 wrapped to WAV in-page, real cost read back from the generation id. No backend.

core.loaded: on first synthesis — a visitor who only reads the page fetches none of it
on page load, to UPGRADE the API that is already published; if this origin is blocked or slow the local implementation serves every action unchanged

api.published_as: window.__tool (assigned during module evaluation — no network wait, no lazy init)
api.ready_event: tool:ready (fires on publish and again on upgrade; window.__toolStatus.ready is the durable fact)

actions.name: synthesize

params.apiKey: optional; falls back to the stored key

actions.returns: { base64, mime, bytes, durationMs, generationId, costUsd, voice, model, tookMs }

actions.name: getLastAudio
actions.returns: the last synthesize result, or null

api.status_probe: window.__toolStatus — { ready, mode: 'local'|'sg-tool-api', methods, engine: { origin, loaded, error } }; always present
